I am a dedicated Computer Science and Engineering student looking for a role where I can apply my knowledge, skills, and passion for technology to provide the best potential I have while gaining hands-on experience and contributing to organizational success.

I am pursuing a BSc in Computer Science and Engineering at the International University of Business Agriculture and Technology (IUBAT), expected in 2026, with a CGPA of 3.79 / 4.00.

My work focuses on full-stack JavaScript: React and Tailwind CSS on the frontend, Node.js, Express.js and RESTful APIs on the backend, and MongoDB for data — with experience in user authentication, session handling, Stripe payment integration and the Gemini API.

projects.title: La Tela Bianca
projects.shortDescription: La Tela Bianca is a two-sided art marketplace (ArtTech / e-commerce) where artists sell, exhibit and take commissions, and collectors discover and buy original art
projects.description:
Overview
La Tela Bianca brings a gallery, a marketplace and an exhibition space together in one platform, built for artists and art lovers in Bangladesh. Artists sell their work directly, with a transparent 5% platform fee. Collectors browse art with its story, rights and provenance shown openly.

Key features

Artist studios: upload artwork with its story and rights information, manage orders and shipping, and track earnings and analytics.
"View in your room": place any artwork on a photo of your own wall at true size, with frame options.
Open requests with sealed bids: a collector describes a piece they want, artists send private bids, and the collector chooses the offer they like best, not just the cheapest.
Commissions: brief → quote → payment → delivery → approval, in one thread.
Private messaging: real-time buyer–artist chat with read receipts (Socket.IO).
Exhibitions with QR-code tickets and check-in.
Master copies of public-domain masterpieces, with copyright checks built in.
Trust and safety: artist verification badges, copyright reporting, watermarked images, and an admin moderation console.
Cash-on-delivery checkout with order tracking; SSLCommerz and Stripe integrations are ready to switch on.
Mobile-first design with light and dark themes.

Engineering highlights

Security hardening:
tiered rate limiting with exponential backoff on sign-in
strict schema validation on all 170 API routes
content-based upload checks with image re-encoding
JWT with refresh-token rotation and optional 2FA
no information leakage in errors
Quality: about 190 automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end), plus accessibility checks (axe-core) and a responsive-layout test that checks 56 pages at 9 screen sizes.
Operations:
CI with GitHub Actions
production configuration that's validated at startup
nightly encrypted database backups
zero known dependency vulnerabilities

Tech stack
React, Vite, Redux Toolkit (RTK Query), Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, Zod, Socket.IO, Sharp, JWT, Argon2, Supabase Storage, Brevo, Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render.

My role
Solo full-stack developer: product design, UI/UX, frontend, backend, database design, security, testing and deployment.

projects.title: Virtual Office System 3D
projects.shortDescription: V-Office is an interactive 3D virtual office full-stack application built for companies operating under modern hybrid work models. Rather than relying on static tabular rosters employees enter a rich, interactive 3D virtual floor plan, locate assigned workstation, click their own chair to check in
projects.description:
### V-Office — Interactive 3D Hybrid Workplace Management Platform

V-Office is a modern **3D virtual office and hybrid workplace management platform** designed to simulate real-world office environments through an interactive digital workspace. The platform enables employees to check in, manage workstation availability, track working sessions, collaborate remotely, and monitor workplace activity through a real-time immersive office experience.

The system features a fully interactive **3D virtual office environment** with a structured 30-desk layout, multiple office zones, realistic lighting, workstation visualization, and intelligent camera navigation. Employees can locate their assigned workspace, access available desks based on work mode, and view live workplace occupancy status.

Built with real-time collaboration in mind, V-Office uses **Socket.IO-based live communication** to synchronize employee presence, desk assignments, check-ins, check-outs, notifications, and activity updates instantly across all connected users.

The platform provides employees with personal dashboards for monitoring work duration, hybrid work patterns, and historical attendance records, while administrators receive a comprehensive management suite for employee control, workstation allocation, workplace analytics, and company-wide activity monitoring.

### Key Capabilities:

* Interactive 3D virtual office environment with realistic workplace visualization
* Digital workstation allocation and access control system
* Real-time employee presence tracking and live status updates
* Hybrid work management (Office Mode & Remote Mode)
* Automated attendance tracking with session management
* Personal productivity dashboard and work history analytics
* Advanced admin panel for employee and workspace management
* Real-time notifications and company activity monitoring

V-Office demonstrates the integration of **3D visualization, real-time web technologies, workplace automation, and enterprise management systems** to create a next-generation digital workplace experience.

projects.title: UrbanStep Retail – Multi-Branch Retail Management System
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack retail ERP for a multi-branch fashion chain: POS, branch-wise inventory, stock transfers, purchasing, returns, reports and role-based access
projects.description:
**Multi-Branch Retail Management System**

* Built a full-featured **multi-branch retail management system** with POS, split payments, loyalty points, printable invoices, branch-wise inventory, and a complete stock-movement ledger.
* Implemented end-to-end **stock transfer workflows** (request → approval → shipping → receiving), purchase orders with supplier balance tracking, and customer/supplier returns with automatic stock and refund adjustments.
* Developed **role-based access control (RBAC)** for five user roles with branch-scoped data access, JWT cookie-based authentication, audit logging, and real-time notifications.
* Created interactive **sales, branch, product, inventory, and profit & loss dashboards** with CSV export, print functionality, responsive layouts, and light/dark mode.
* Built and maintained **55 automated tests** covering core business workflows, endpoint-level permission matrices, concurrency scenarios, and security cases.
